responsibility: Implements GCC’s core edge and value profiling pass for profile generation and profile use on CFGs. It chooses which CFG arcs to instrument by building a spanning tree that avoids abnormal, fake, and expensive edges where possible, inserts GIMPLE profiler code for arc counters and requested value histograms, reads back gcda counts and histograms during profile-use, reconstructs basic-block and edge execution counts and branch probabilities from the instrumented subset, updates loop iteration estimates and function frequencies, and maintains the bb/edge-to-gcov counter mappings and global gcov summary state used by the rest of the compiler.
same_name_distinction: This source file is the main CFG profiling implementation behind gcc/profile.h: it selects arcs to instrument with a spanning tree, inserts GIMPLE edge and value-profiler code, reads back counts, reconstructs block/edge frequencies and probabilities, and updates loop/function frequency data. The same-stem header only shares lightweight data structures, mappings, and helper declarations used by profiling consumers.
